captions: Seli arrived here with three families after dark. I entered their arrival in the town record. Then I wrote that a change in the Grid had driven them down from the pass.
She had said they were afraid of the sound under the ice. I turned her fear into my explanation, and people repeated it as a measured cause. She has every right to be angry with me.
I have made three lamps so I cannot do it again unnoticed: what we observed, what a person reported, and what we inferred. Will you help me light all three without asking one to impersonate another?

choices.text: I’ll keep the three accounts visible

greeting.repeatText: Will you help me test this account?

context.text: She can tell you what she heard, what she chose, and what the record changed.

hint:mission:antipion:speech.text: Intuition will show the next unfinished step.

choices.text: I’ll mark observation, testimony, and inference separately

actions.value: I’ll mark observation, testimony, and inference separately

choices.text: Guide me to the next step

hint:mission:antipion:speech.readyText: The test holds. Let us record what we can promise.

captions: Seli read the new entry. She did not forgive the first one simply because we fixed it, but she said this one sounds like her.
Will you bring Saima the corrected record?

completed.text: I still ask Seli whether I have written what she meant.

locked.text: Saima is comparing the local readings first. Bring her that result; then we can test its reach here.
